claim_boundary: G10 audits whether the measured heat-capacity data can replace the missing fourth response channel. Theory curves and the second-device unnormalized estimate are not experimental replacement surfaces. No Pluecker residual or significance is computed.
decisive_reason: Measured density-resolved heat-capacity curves stop at 100 K, below the 110 K lower bound of the current base-channel range. The measured 15-195 K temperature sweep is at one fixed carrier density and therefore cannot supply local derivatives in both T and n.
